cases.sentence: ___ упорно молчал, но когда Корней сказал ему, что за это его согнать следует, Капитоныч подскочил к нему.
cases.translation: The doorman stubbornly kept silent, but when Korney told him he ought to be driven out for it, Kapitonych jumped up to him.
cases.explain: «Швейцар» is the subject of «молчал», so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Василий Лукич между тем, не понимавший сначала, кто была эта дама, и узнав из ___, что это была та самая мать, которая бросила мужа и которую он не знал, так как поступил в дом уже после нее, был в сомнении, войти ли ему, или нет, или сообщить Алексею Александровичу.
cases.translation: Vasily Lukitch, who at first did not understand who this lady was and, learning from the ___, that this was the very mother who had abandoned her husband and whom he did not know since he had entered the house after her, was uncertain whether to enter or not, or to inform Alexei Alexandrovich.
cases.explain: The preposition «из» governs the Genitive case: «из разговора».

cases.sentence: «Барыня, голубушка!» — заговорила няня, подходя к ___ и целуя ее руки и плечи.
cases.translation: 'My lady, my dear!' the nurse began, approaching Anna and kissing her hands and shoulders.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» governs the Dative case: «к Анне».

cases.sentence: Няня испуганным шепотом сказала: «Идет!» — и подала ___ Анне.
cases.translation: and the nurse said in a frightened whisper... 'He's coming!' — and handed the hat to Anna.
cases.explain: «Шляпу» is the direct object of the transitive verb «подала», hence Accusative.

cases.sentence: Он покачал ___ и, вздохнув, затворил дверь.
cases.translation: He shook his head and, sighing, closed the door.
cases.explain: The verb «покачал» governs the Instrumental case in the idiom «покачать головой» ("to shake one's head").

cases.sentence: Он был в ___, войти ли ему или нет, или сообщить Алексею Александровичу.
cases.translation: he was in doubt whether to go in or not, or to tell Alexei Alexandrovich.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» (expressing a state) governs the Prepositional case: «в сомнении».

reading.ru: Василий Лукич, между тем, не понимавшись сначала, кто была эта дама, и узнав из разговора, что это была та самая мать, которая бросила мужа и который он не знал, так как поступил в дом уже после нее, был в сомнении, войти ли ему или нет, или сообщить Алексею Александровичу.
reading.question: Why was Vasily Lukich unsure whether to go in?
options: He did not know at first who the lady was and was uncertain whether to interrupt or tell Alexei Alexandrovich
He was afraid of Sergei Alexandrovich
He had been told never to enter the nursery
reading.correct: He did not know at first who the lady was and was uncertain whether to interrupt or tell Alexei Alexandrovich
reading.explain: Vasily Lukich did not at first understand who the lady was, and once he realized it was Seryozha's mother, he was unsure whether to go in or report to Alexei Alexandrovich.

reading.ru: Но ласки матери и сына, звуки их голосов и то, что они говорили, все это заставило его изменить намерение.
reading.question: What made Vasily Lukich change his mind about interrupting?
options: The tenderness between mother and son and the sound of their voices
A direct order from Alexei Alexandrovich
reading.correct: The tenderness between mother and son and the sound of their voices
reading.explain: The text says the caresses of mother and son and the sound of their voices made him change his intention.

reading.ru: Между прислугой дома в это же время происходило сильное волнение.
reading.question: What was happening among the household servants at this time?
options: Strong agitation, because they knew the master and mistress must not meet
A quiet celebration of Seryozha's birthday
reading.correct: Strong agitation, because they knew the master and mistress must not meet
reading.explain: The passage says there was strong agitation among the servants because everyone understood the spouses must not meet.

reading.ru: Корней, камердинер, войдя в швейцарскую, спрашивал, кто и как пропустил ее, и, узнав, что Капитоныч принял и проводил ее, выговаривал старику.
reading.question: What did Korney the valet do upon entering the entryway?
options: He questioned who had let Anna in
He sent for Alexei Alexandrovich immediately
reading.correct: He questioned who had let Anna in
reading.explain: Korney asked who had let her in and, learning it was Kapitonych, scolded the old man.

reading.ru: Десять лет служил, кроме милости ничего не видал.
reading.question: How did Kapitonych defend himself against Korney's scolding?
options: By pointing out he had served ten years and known only kindness
By claiming he never saw the visitor
reading.correct: By pointing out he had served ten years and known only kindness
reading.explain: Kapitonych protests that he has served ten years and seen nothing but kindness.

reading.ru: Когда няня вошла в детскую, Сережа рассказывал матери о том, как они упали вместе с Наденькой, покатившись с горы, и три раза перекувырнулись.
reading.question: What was Seryozha telling his mother when the nanny entered the nursery?
options: How he and Nadenka had tumbled down a hill and somersaulted three times
About his lessons with Vasily Lukich
reading.correct: How he and Nadenka had tumbled down a hill and somersaulted three times
reading.explain: Seryozha was telling his mother about falling down a hill with Nadenka and turning three somersaults.

reading.ru: Надо было уходить, надо было оставить его.
reading.question: What was Anna's overwhelming thought as she sat with Seryozha?
options: That she had to leave and abandon him
That she should take him away with her
That she should confront Alexei Alexandrovich
reading.correct: That she had to leave and abandon him
reading.explain: The text says this alone was what she thought and felt: she had to go, she had to leave him.

reading.ru: Няня вдруг заплакала и опять стала целовать ее руку.
reading.question: How did the nanny react upon seeing Anna again?
options: She suddenly burst into tears and kept kissing Anna's hand
She ran to fetch Alexei Alexandrovich
reading.correct: She suddenly burst into tears and kept kissing Anna's hand
reading.explain: The nanny suddenly began to cry and kept kissing Anna's hand.

reading.ru: Сережа, сияя глазами и улыбкой, и держась одной рукой за мать, другую за няню, топотал по ковру жирными голыми ножками.
reading.question: How did Seryozha behave while holding onto his mother and the nanny?
options: He stamped happily on the rug with his bare fat feet, radiant with joy
He cried and hid his face
He ran out of the room
reading.correct: He stamped happily on the rug with his bare fat feet, radiant with joy
reading.explain: Seryozha, his eyes and smile radiant, held his mother with one hand and the nanny with the other, stamping on the rug with his bare, chubby feet.

reading.ru: Он понял, что она была несчастлива и любила его.
reading.question: What did Seryozha come to understand about his mother?
options: That she was unhappy and that she loved him
That she no longer loved him
That she was angry at him
That she was leaving forever without regret
reading.correct: That she was unhappy and that she loved him
reading.explain: The text states he understood that she was unhappy and that she loved him.

reading.ru: Он видел, что она страдает, и ему было жаль ее.
reading.question: How did Seryozha feel upon seeing his mother's distress?
reading.explain: The text says he saw that she was suffering and felt sorry for her.

reading.ru: Сережа опустился в постель и зарыдал, закрыв лицо руками.
reading.question: What did Seryozha do after his mother had to leave?
options: He sank onto the bed and sobbed, covering his face with his hands
He ran after her into the hallway
reading.correct: He sank onto the bed and sobbed, covering his face with his hands
reading.explain: Seryozha sank down onto the bed and burst into sobs, covering his face with his hands.

reading.ru: Она быстрым движением опустила вуаль и, прибавив шагу, почти выбежала из комнаты.
reading.question: What did Anna feel and do upon seeing Alexei Alexandrovich?
options: A feeling of disgust and malice toward him, and she lowered her veil and hurried out
She fainted at the sight of him
She stopped to speak with him at length
reading.correct: A feeling of disgust and malice toward him, and she lowered her veil and hurried out
reading.explain: A feeling of revulsion and anger toward him, along with envy over their son, seized her, and she quickly lowered her veil and almost ran out of the room.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows that someone changed their mind because of the emotional affection between mother and son?
sentences: Но ласки матери и сына, звуки их голосов и то, что они говорили, – все это заставило его изменить намерение.
Он покачал головой и, вздохнув, затворил дверь.
«Подожду еще десять минут», – сказал он себе, откашливаясь и утирая слезы.
highlight.explain: The first sentence explains how the sounds of their voices and their interaction caused him to abandon his original intention.

highlight.question: Which sentence explains why the servants understood they must prevent a meeting between the spouses?
sentences: Между прислугой дома в это же время происходило сильное волнение.

Все узнали, что приехала барыня, и что Капитоныч пустил ее, и что она теперь в детской, а между тем барин всегда в девятом часу сам заходит в детскую, и все понимали, что встреча супругов невозможна и что надо помешать ей.
Корней, камердинер, войдя в швейцарскую, спрашивал, кто и как пропустил ее, и, узнав, что Капитоныч принял и проводил ее, выговаривал старику.
Швейцар упорно молчал, но когда Корней сказал ему, что за это его согнать следует, Капитоныч подскочил к нему и, замахав руками пред лицом Корнея, заговорил:
highlight.explain: This sentence clarifies that the master always enters the nursery at nine o'clock, making a meeting between husband and wife impossible unless prevented.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows Korney asking the nanny to judge the doorman's actions?
sentences: – презрительно сказал Корней и повернулся ко входившей няне.
– Вот судите, Марья Ефимовна: – впустил, никому не сказал, – обратился к ней Корней.
– Алексей Александрович сейчас выйдут, пойдут в детскую.
highlight.explain: Korney directly addresses the nanny, asking her to judge how Kapitanich let the mistress in without informing anyone.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows Anna hearing footsteps but remaining paralyzed, unable to speak or move?
sentences: Когда няня вошла в детскую, Сережа рассказывал матери о том, как они упали вместе с Наденькой, покатившись с горы, и три раза перекувырнулись.
Она слушала звуки его голоса, видела его лицо и игру выражения, ощущала его руку, но не понимала того, что он говорил.
Надо было уходить, надо было оставить его, – только одно это и думала и чувствовала она.
Она слышала и шаги Василия Лукича, подходившего к двери и кашлявшего, слышала и шаги подходившей няни; но сидела, как окаменелая, не в силах ни начать говорить, ни встать.
highlight.explain: This sentence describes how she sat frozen like stone, hearing footsteps but unable to begin speaking or rise from her seat.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows that Anna expressed her farewell through her facial expression rather than words?
sentences: Она не могла сказать прощай, но выражение ее лица сказало это, и он понял.
– Милый, милый Кутик!
– проговорила она имя, которым звала его маленьким, – ты не забудешь меня?
– но больше она не могла говорить.
highlight.explain: The first sentence states she could not say goodbye aloud, but her face communicated it, and Seryozha understood.

highlight.question: Which two sentences show what Seryozha understood from the nanny's whispered words about his parents?
sentences: Но Сережа понял все, что она хотела сказать ему.
Он понял, что она была несчастлива и любила его.
Он понял даже то, что шепотом говорила няня.
Он слышал слова: – «Всегда в девятом часу», и он понял, что это говорилось про отца и что матери с отцом нельзя встречаться.
Это он понимал, но одного он не мог понять: – почему на ее лице показались испуг и стыд?..
highlight.explain: These sentences explain that he understood the nanny's whispered words and comprehended that his parents could not meet because his father arrives at nine o'clock.
